title: Pure Anotherverse
summary: Pure Anotherverse Normal Monster beatdown and control, combining the prize-card Anotherverse quartet (Gluttonia, Stratios, Dragon and Solaria) with Normal Monster Spells and omni-negate Counter Traps.

summary.title: Starters & Searchers
points: Unexpected Dai Special Summons Level 4 Anotherverse Dragon (2000 ATK) or Anotherverse Solaria (2000 DEF) straight from the Deck while you control no monsters.
Painful Decision sends a Level 4 Normal Monster from the Deck to the GY to add another copy of that card from the Deck to your hand.
Summoner's Art searches Level 8 Anotherverse Gluttonia or Anotherverse Stratios (both 2500 ATK/2000 DEF) from the Deck with no cost, and Ancient Rules Special Summons them from the hand.

summary.title: Opening: Unexpected Dai + Summoner's Art + Piercing the Darkness
steps: Activate Piercing the Darkness, then play Unexpected Dai to Special Summon Anotherverse Dragon from the Deck; Piercing the Darkness triggers to draw 1 card.
Activate Summoner's Art to search Anotherverse Gluttonia or Anotherverse Stratios, then play Ancient Rules to Special Summon it from the hand.

If you opened extra Level 4s, convert one into Link Spider to Special Summon another Level 4 Normal Monster from your hand, or Link Summon Hieratic Seal of the Heavenly Spheres using Anotherverse Dragon and another Dragon.
Set Champion's Vigilance and Fists of the Unrivaled Tenyi backed by your face-up Level 8 Normal Monster.

summary.title: Piercing the Darkness
summary.text: Piercing the Darkness is both the draw engine and the combat win condition: once per turn when you Normal or Special Summon a non-Token Normal Monster, you draw a card, and whenever one of your Normal Monsters (or an Extra Deck monster using a Normal Monster as material) battles an opponent's monster, it gains ATK equal to that opponent's monster's ATK, guaranteeing that 2000–2500 ATK Anotherverse monsters win every battle.

summary.title: Counter Traps & Extra Deck
points: Champion's Vigilance (Limited) negates a monster Summon or a Spell/Trap activation at no cost while you control a Level 7 or higher Normal Monster (Anotherverse Gluttonia or Stratios).

Fists of the Unrivaled Tenyi negates any monster effect or Spell/Trap activation while you control any face-up non-Effect Monster, and Special Summons Blue-Eyes Tyrant Dragon from the Extra Deck if destroyed while Set.
Hieratic Seal of the Heavenly Spheres tributes itself on the opponent's turn to bounce a face-up card and Special Summon Anotherverse Dragon from the Deck.

allow.Unexpected Dai: Special Summons Anotherverse Dragon or Anotherverse Solaria directly from the Deck if you control no monsters.
allow.Summoner's Art: Searches the Level 8 Anotherverse Gluttonia or Anotherverse Stratios directly from the Deck.
allow.Ancient Rules: Special Summons Level 8 Anotherverse Normal Monsters directly from the hand.
allow.Painful Decision: Sends a Level 4 Anotherverse Normal Monster to the GY to add another copy to the hand.
allow.Piercing the Darkness: Continuous Spell that draws a card on Normal Monster summon and grants them massive ATK boosts during battle.
allow.Champion's Vigilance: Counter Trap that becomes an omni-negate while you control a Level 7 or higher Normal Monster.
allow.Fists of the Unrivaled Tenyi: Counter Trap that negates Spell/Trap or monster effects while you control a face-up non-Effect Monster.
allow.Link Spider: Converts a Level 4 Anotherverse Normal Monster into an Effect Monster and extends from hand.
allow.Hieratic Seal of the Heavenly Spheres: Link-2 Dragon made using Anotherverse Dragon that bounces an opposing card and summons a Dragon from Deck.
allow.Blue-Eyes Tyrant Dragon: Can be summoned via Fists of the Unrivaled Tenyi when destroyed.

main: Anotherverse Gluttonia
Level 8 DARK Fiend Normal Monster with 2500 ATK/2000 DEF searchable via Summoner's Art.
Anotherverse Stratios
Level 8 EARTH Warrior Normal Monster with 2500 ATK/2000 DEF for Ancient Rules and Champion's Vigilance.
Anotherverse Dragon
Level 4 LIGHT Dragon Normal Monster with 2000 ATK summoned via Unexpected Dai.
Anotherverse Solaria
Level 4 LIGHT Spellcaster Normal Monster with 2000 DEF for Unexpected Dai and Rank 4 plays.
Unexpected Dai
Summons Anotherverse Dragon or Solaria directly from the Deck to start plays without using the Normal Summon.
Summoner's Art
Searches Anotherverse Gluttonia or Stratios with zero cost.
Ancient Rules
Special Summons Gluttonia or Stratios from hand to trigger Piercing the Darkness.
Painful Decision
Thins the deck and searches Anotherverse Dragon or Solaria.
Piercing the Darkness
Draws 1 card per turn on Normal Monster summon and adds the opponent's ATK to your battling Normal Monster.
Champion's Vigilance
Negates any Summon or Spell/Trap activation while Gluttonia or Stratios is on the field.
Fists of the Unrivaled Tenyi
Negates monster effects or Spell/Traps while any Anotherverse monster is face-up.

Hieratic Seal of the Heavenly Spheres

Summoned from the Extra Deck if Fists of the Unrivaled Tenyi is destroyed in the Spell & Trap Zone.
